analysis_scope: Selected marginal/path/dependence summaries; no raw observation vectors
command: python -m tools.compare_market tests/AFLT_day.csv --format aflt-day --timezone Europe/Moscow --config docs/evidence/reference-aflt-config.json --output docs/evidence/reference-aflt.json --markdown docs/evidence/reference-aflt.md

comparison.decision_scope: Only supplied absolute tolerances; no universal model acceptance or forecast claim

notes: Descriptive diagnostics are not evidence of universal market realism or investment suitability.
Variance uses ddof=1; skewness and excess kurtosis use adjusted Fisher estimators; quantiles use linear interpolation.
Tails are inclusive observations at/beyond empirical 5% and 95% quantiles; Tukey outliers use 1.5 IQR fences; 3σ uses population deviation.
ACF uses observation lags, global centering and a full-sample denominator; irregular cadence is not resampled.
Domain-invalid returns remain aligned nulls; marginal summaries exclude them; ACF does not compress gaps.
ProbabilityTolerance applies only to independent Bernoulli generator events with a predeclared confidence and sample size.
Drawdown is a positive peak-to-trough fraction; duration counts consecutive underwater observed bars, including unrecovered periods.

interpretation: Metric differences describe this reference window and this one seeded scenario. No universal realism, model acceptance, calibration, forecast or market-mechanics claim. A null tolerance decision means no threshold was supplied or the metric was undefined.

procedure.generator_inputs: Explicit complete configuration in scenario_manifest; defaults are library defaults, never inferred from reference data

reference.source_limit: Caller-supplied data; venue, instrument identity, volume units and price-adjustment policy were not independently verified
reference.timestamp_policy: Preserve observed rows and gaps; timezone is caller-supplied, not inferred from the instrument or filename
